annotations.title: Resolve an Irish place to every geography code

description: All geography codes for an Irish place: county, province, council, LEA, Dáil constituency, NUTS3, electoral division (ED) and, for lat/lon, small area, with population shares where areas straddle. Takes a name (English or Irish, 'Co. Mayo', 'Dublin 8', 'Tallaght Central, South Dublin'), an ED/small-area/NUTS3 code, or lat/lon. list returns the EDs, LEAs, constituencies or councils inside.

list.description: List areas of this level inside the place.
